svg.title: Six products of a human chromosome 4;12 translocation
svg.desc: Adjacent-1 (25%) yields 1 + 2 or 3 + 4. Adjacent-2 (25%) yields 1 + 3 or 2 + 4. All adjacent types have a duplicated and a missing interval. Alternate (50%) yields 1 + 4 or 2 + 3: 25% balanced translocation and 25% normal. Each type is shown once. Gold marks chromosome 4 ancestry and green marks chromosome 12 ancestry. Percentages are those assumed in the lecture example.
